descriptions.rule: Automatically choose proxies according to the rule set.
descriptions.global: Forward all network requests through the selected proxy.
descriptions.direct: Bypass the proxy and connect to the internet directly.

account.title: Account
account.planExpiredContinue: Plan expired. Please renew to continue.
account.dataExhaustedContinue: Data used up. Please renew to continue.
account.expiringSoon: Your plan expires soon. Please renew.

compatibility.permissionBody: Allow PewPew Cloud Client to install or use its background service and route application traffic? Your system may request administrator permission. Switching may briefly interrupt connections.
compatibility.changeFailed: Switching did not complete. Check system permission or try again.
compatibility.serviceConflict: Another client's background service was detected. Enhanced mode was not enabled. Contact support.
compatibility.rollbackFailed: The connection could not be fully restored. Use Repair Network or contact support.
compatibility.udpUnsupported: UDP is disabled on this route. Voice may not connect. Try another route.
compatibility.checkFailed: Unable to read connection status. Try again.
compatibility.standardHint: Works for browsers and most apps
compatibility.enhancedHint: For games, Discord voice and apps that ignore the system proxy. Needs permission the first time.
compatibility.serviceUnavailable: The background service isn't ready. Enhanced mode needs system permission. Please try again.
compatibility.permissionDenied: Enhanced mode needs your permission. Try again and choose Yes in the Windows prompt.
compatibility.serviceInstallFailed: The background service couldn't be installed. Restart the client and try again. If this continues, copy diagnostics for support.
compatibility.summaryCoreDown: The connection core isn't running. Use Repair Network or restart the client.
compatibility.summaryEnhancedActive: Enhanced routing is enabled. Test your game or voice connection to confirm.
compatibility.summaryEnhancedMissing: The system proxy is on, but enhanced routing isn't active. Reconnect or use Repair Network.
compatibility.summaryStandardActive: Standard connection is active. If games or voice don't connect, switch to Enhanced.

connectionStatus.connectFailed: Connection failed. Retry or repair the network.

connectionStatus.verificationFailed: The connection settings didn't take effect. Try again or use Repair Network.

connection.directModeBeforeConnect: Direct mode is on. Connecting will switch to Smart Mode.
